This is Instar: a cage of fruit flies on a bench, running ten ticks a second, whether or not anyone is watching.
Each fly is driven by the complete wiring of a real fly's nervous system: 166,700 neurons and 6.2 million connections, from Janelia's male C-N-S connectome. Nothing is scripted.
This is one fly's brain firing, neuron by neuron, grouped by role: sensory, descending, leg, wing, proboscis.
Every fly is an NFT on Solana. Buy a newborn and you are its keeper. When it dies, the NFT burns and its vault is paid out by rule.
Every 2,400 ticks the world hashes itself and posts the hash to the chain. Anyone can replay it and check.
Instar cage dot com. The wiring is real. The dynamics are ours. Don't take our word for it.
